audit.duplicate_limitations: No guarantee for rotations, nonidentical crops, or unrecorded rolls
audit.label_definition: At least one exact-white (255) annotated defect pixel; normal status explicitly confirmed
audit.mask_policy: Intermediate edge intensities excluded; exact 255 agrees with publisher CSV defect areas. Raw mask bytes preserved.
audit.physical_roll_information: Not assumed; only use an explicitly documented group column
audit.group_origin: Explicit join through publisher HighRes_Metadata.csv; no filename inference

sample_note: Authentic engineering sample; retains original full-study assignments. Deliberate class oversampling, not population prevalence. Never assessed final evidence.
